# 1. Purpose

## 1.1 Purpose

The Issue Execution Plan (IEP) is the operational planning and execution document for a single GitHub Issue.

It provides:

- implementation planning,
- decision tracking,
- implementation traceability,
- milestone planning,
- continuation across milestones and chat sessions.

The IEP has **no normative authority**.

It supplements the canonical documentation and references approved governance and architecture artifacts.

---

## 1.2 Governance References

This document shall be used together with the canonical governance documentation, including:

- Governance Foundation
- Traceability Model
- Architecture Intent Protection Gate (AIPG)
- Architecture Decision Records (ADR)
- Decision Records
- Work Packages
